title: When the Verdict Breaks
author: K. M. Winterbourne
blurb: Ulyana Kavanagh, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
